title: Card 7: do alag DB ek transaction me nahi aate. Har kadam ka haal likho; fail to wahi kadam dobara, peeche nahi

callouts.green: Galat: match ke baad sauda pakka hai, bechne wale ko 20k mil chuke

callouts.red: Dono DB me ek hi transaction?
callouts.green: Nahi ban sakti. Isliye har kadam ka haal likho, dobara aage hi

callouts.red: Portfolio DB fail, share nahi aaye
callouts.green: Likhe hue haal se dobara koshish, aage hi, jab tak SETTLED
Trade PENDING + alert, ops share daalta. Arpan dobara order na kare: naya + purana dono = 10 INFY, paisa do baar

callouts.red: Dobara chalane pe kuch do baar ho gaya? Har kadam trade_id se, ho chuka = kuch mat karo. Match se pehle atka? Tab ulta (SAGA): block hatao.
callouts.green: Keemat: beech me PENDING dikhta, par lamba lock (2PC) nahi. Ek jagah (orchestrator) se dikhta kaunsa kadam atka

kyun: Do alag DB me ek transaction nahi ban sakti. Har kadam ka haal likho (wallet done, portfolio done). Fail hua to wahin se dobara, aage hi. Sauda pakka hai, ulta nahi. Arpan ko beech me PENDING
peeche: card 6 me chaaron badlaav ek transaction me
ab: Dopahar Arpan ka INFY ka 20k kata (Wallet DB), share nahi aaye (Portfolio DB)
agla: ab andar sab theek. Par bahar 10 lakh log price maang rahe (card 8)
